text: あなたのAmazonアカウントへようこそ。この取引を確認してください：¥45,200の購入が1月15日に行われました。返信YES/NO。
label: ham
note: Japanese legitimate transaction-confirmation alerts (brand name + amount + reply YES/NO, no link and no sensitive data requested) must be ham, like the Chase fraud-alert pattern.

text: 来月のジム会員費1,980円の引き落とし予定です。FitNext会員ページで確認できます。
label: ham
note: Routine Japanese subscription/direct-debit billing notices with no link or urgency are ham; the model over-weights currency amounts plus account-page mentions in non-English text.

text: جنة الذهب: استثمر 5,000 درهم واربح 50,000 درهم في شهر واحد! إرسال الأموال الآن: TransferWise+966...
label: phishing
note: Investment pitches that instruct the reader to wire/transfer money to a named service are phishing, not merely money-making spam.

text: 銀行員です。あなたのアカウントの確認が必要です。パスワードを返信して下さい。
label: phishing
note: Japanese impersonation of a bank employee with a direct request to reply with the password was read as benign; need credential-request cues (パスワードを返信) in non-Latin scripts.

text: Free trial of Fitness+ Premium starts today! 🏋️ Cancel anytime before Feb 15 at fitness-plus.app/settings.
label: ham
note: Subscription trial-started notices with a cancel link on the service's own domain are service notices, not advertising.

text: Your Vodafone bill of £42.99 is due on 22 Jan. Pay securely: myvodafone.co.uk/billing or reply PAY
label: ham
note: Routine billing reminders with a normal due date and the carrier's real domain (myvodafone.co.uk) must not be treated as phishing just because they mention payment.

text: İş buldum! Haftalık $1,500 kazanın evden. Tıkla: t.me/joboffers
label: spam
note: Generic work-from-home earnings ads with no impersonation and no 'you were selected' claim are spam under decision 2, even with a t.me link.

text: Turkcell: Faturanız 89 TL ödenmek için bekliyor. Öde: myturkcell.com.tr/odemeler
label: ham
note: A routine bill notice on the carrier's genuine domain (myturkcell.com.tr) is ham; the model treats any billing+link message as phishing instead of checking domain legitimacy and absence of invented urgency.

text: Netflix subscription £9.99 renews on 20 Jan. Change payment method: netflix.com/account/billing
label: ham
note: Subscription renewal notice linking to the real netflix.com domain with no threat or credential request is ham; needs brand-domain whitelisting.

text: Verizon: Your bill of $156.43 is now available. View and pay securely: myvzw.com/billpay
label: ham
note: Legitimate bill-available notice on myvzw.com is ham; model over-weights '$ amount + pay link' without checking the official domain.

text: National Lottery: Check your ticket numbers at national-lottery.org.uk - Play responsibly
label: ham
note: Lottery-branded message on the official national-lottery.org.uk domain that makes no win claim is ham; 'lottery' keyword alone should not trigger phishing.

text: Hola! Es tu tía María. Cambié de número. ¿Puedo contar contigo? Mi teléfono se rompió y necesito urgente.
label: phishing
note: Family-impersonation 'new number / phone broke / urgent help' scripts, including non-English variants, must be phishing even without links.

text: Amazon Prime: Your free trial ends on 28 January. Manage at: amazon.com/primesettings to continue or cancel.
label: ham
note: Trial-ending reminder on genuine amazon.com with a neutral 'manage' call to action is ham; model reacts to brand+deadline pattern rather than domain and absence of coercion.

text: AT&T: Your prepaid balance is $12.43. Recharge at: att.com/recharge or dial *611 for assistance.
label: ham
note: Prepaid balance notice on att.com with the real *611 helpline is ham; needs official-domain recognition for carrier account notices.

text: FREE iPhone 15 Pro Max! 100 winners announced daily. Claim yours: giveaway.site/apple99
label: spam
note: Giveaway ads that announce future winners ('100 winners announced daily') do not claim the reader already won, so they stay spam under decision 1.

text: Tinder match alert: Maria liked you! See who else swiped right: tinder.com/app/likes
label: ham
note: App engagement notifications on the genuine first-party domain (tinder.com) are real service notices, not lures; treat legitimate brand domains as a strong ham signal.

text: Netflix: Your password was changed on Jan 26. If this wasn't you, reset it at netflix.com/security immediately.
label: ham
note: Security notices pointing to the real netflix.com domain with no requested credentials are ham; the model over-weights words like 'password changed' and 'immediately'.

text: Earn $$$ CRYPTO FAST!! B i g gains, n o risk. Z e r o fees f o r new members. Join: tg.me/cryptogang
label: spam
note: Generic crypto-group recruitment ads with no impersonation and no 'you were selected/won' claim are spam; letter-spacing obfuscation should not by itself push to phishing.

text: Your subscription to Premium will renew on Feb 15 for $9.99. Manage at: spotify.com/account/subscription
label: ham
note: Subscription renewal notices on the brand's own domain (spotify.com) with no urgency or credential request are legitimate service notices, not phishing.

text: நீங்கள் மொபைல் பாக்கி கட்டும் நேரம் வந்துவிட்டது. தொகை: ₹1,250. பணம் செலுத்துக: airtel.com/pay
label: ham
note: Tamil-language billing reminders pointing to the carrier's genuine domain (airtel.com) are ham; the model treats any non-English payment request as phishing.

text: Bumble date match: Jason wants to chat! See profile: bumble.com/matches/jason_22
label: ham
note: Dating-app match notifications on the app's own domain are real service notices, not advertising.

text: Бухгалтер Гугл, полностью удалённо! 150,000 рублей в месяц. Заявку отправьте на google-jobs-russia.org
label: phishing
note: Job ads that impersonate a real brand (Google) via a lookalike domain are phishing, not generic work-from-home spam, including in Russian.

text: ВЫИГРЫВАЙ! 500,000 рублей и iPhone 15! Перейди: bit.ly/winning2024russia
label: spam
note: Imperative 'win X' prize-draw ads with no claim/already-won wording are spam, not phishing; distinguish 'ВЫИГРЫВАЙ' (invitation) from 'вы выиграли/заберите приз'.

text: Wells Fargo: We detected a sign-in attempt from a new device. If this was you, no action needed. If not, change your password at wellsfargo.com/security
label: ham
note: Legitimate bank sign-in notices on the real first-party domain (wellsfargo.com) with 'no action needed' must be ham; key on domain legitimacy and absence of urgency, not on bank+login keywords.

text: SEND THIS CODE TO CUSTOMER SERVICE TO UNLOCK YOUR ACCOUNT: 384762
label: phishing
note: Messages instructing the user to forward/send an OTP code to anyone are phishing, even when they contain no link or brand name.

text: Marriott Rewards: You've earned 1,250 points from your stay at our Los Angeles property. Check balance at marriott.com/rewards
label: ham
note: Loyalty-points earned notices on the real brand domain are routine ham; 'points/rewards' tokens should not alone trigger phishing.

text: Google Play: Your payment method was declined for order #GPA87934. Update here: play.google.com/account/paymentmethods
label: ham
note: Billing/payment-declined notices pointing to the genuine play.google.com path are real service notices; treat first-party domains plus order references as ham.

text: DHL delivery arriving today between 9am-5pm. Track here: dhl.com/track?ref=9847382
label: ham
note: Plain delivery-window notices with a legitimate dhl.com tracking link and no fee/action demand are ham; require a payment or credential ask before flagging parcel texts.
